'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[2026 Strait of Hormuz campaign]]
*****[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces a [[U.S. Navy|U.S. naval]] [[blockade]] of Iran and the strait "effective immediately," which will "seek and interdict" any vessel that paid Iran's toll to cross the strait. [https://www.axios.com/2026/04/12/trump-naval-blockade-iran-strait-hormuz-peace-talks (''Axios'')]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Arab countries]]
****[[2026 Iranian strikes on Saudi Arabia]]
*****[[Saudi Arabia]] announces the restoration of its [[East–West Crude Oil Pipeline]] and other [[Energy in Saudi Arabia|energy]] facilities following an Iranian attack. [https://www.nst.com.my/business/economy/2026/04/1416066/saudi-says-east-west-pipeline-energy-facilities-restored-after (AFP via ''New Straits Times'')] [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/saudi-arabia-restores-full-capacity-east-west-oil-pipeline-7-million-bpd-after-2026-04-12/ (Reuters)]
***[[2026 Iran war ceasefire]]
****The initial three rounds of [[ceasefire]] [[Islamabad Talks|talks]] between [[Iran]] and the [[United States]] conclude in [[Islamabad]], [[Pakistan]], after 14 hours. However, the [[Government of Iran|Iranian government]] says that negotiations will continue. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/us-israel-iran-war/third-round-of-iran-us-talks-concludes-in-pakistan-expert-teams-continue-text-exchanges/3902475 (AA)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/us-iran-talks-pause-now-disagreements-remain-2026-04-11/ (Reuters)]
****[[Vice President of the United States|U.S. vice president]] [[JD Vance]], who led the American delegation in the ceasefire talks, says that the two sides have not reached a deal to end the war, with disagreement over [[Nuclear program of Iran|nuclear weapon development]], and that the U.S. made its "final and best offer" and stated "We'll see if the Iranians accept it". [https://aje.news/x545rk?update=4484682 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/world/iran/live-blog/live-updates-trump-iran-hormuz-israel-lebanon-ceasefire-talks-pakistan-rcna285140/rcrd107713?canonicalCard=true (NBC News)]
****[[Deputy Prime Minister of Pakistan|Pakistani deputy prime minister]] [[Ishaq Dar]] urges Iran and the U.S. to uphold their commitment to observe a [[ceasefire]] after Vance said that both sides didn't reach an agreement. Dar also says that Pakistan will continue to play its role in facilitating engagement and dialogue between both sides. [https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2639621/pakistan (''Arab News PK'')]
****Pakistani sources say that the major disagreements during the talks were Iran's nuclear program, [[Ballistic missile program of Iran|missile program]], restrictions in the [[Strait of Hormuz]], and calls for a [[ceasefire]] in [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.newarab.com/news/us-iran-talks-failed-over-hormuz-lebanon-and-nuclear-programme (MENA via ''The New Arab'')]
***The Iranian government updates the death toll in Iran to 3,375 people. [https://aje.news/x545rk?update=4485778 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]	
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****At least 24 people are killed by [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s across [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://aje.news/x545rk?update=4485229 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
***[[Gaza war]]
****The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] claims that they have killed several [[Hamas]] terrorists who took part in [[Gaza war hostage crisis|hostage-taking]] during the [[October 7 attacks]], including [[Nukhba forces|Nukhba]] commander Ali Sami Mohammad Shakra, in a strike in central [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] yesterday that killed seven people. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-892753#google_vignette (''The Jerusalem Post'')] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-says-hamas-terrorists-who-abducted-held-hostages-were-killed-in-gaza-strike/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*Three [[Pakistan Coast Guard]] personnel are killed when [[Balochistan Liberation Army]] militants open fire on a patrol boat in the [[Arabian Sea]] near the [[Iran–Pakistan border]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/three-killed-armed-men-attack-pakistan-coast-guards-arabian-sea-2026-04-12/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Azerbaijan–Iran relations]]
**[[Azerbaijan]]'s embassy in [[Tehran]] resumes its operations during the ceasefire, initially with a limited staff. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/eurasia/azerbaijans-embassy-in-tehran-resumes-operations-amid-2-week-us-iran-ceasefire/3902986 (AA)]
*[[Iraq–Saudi Arabia relations]]
**The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Saudi Arabia)|Saudi foreign ministry]] summons the ambassador of [[Iraq]] over "continued attacks and threats" against it and other [[Arab states of the Persian Gulf|Gulf Arab states]] from Iraqi territory. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/us-israel-iran-war/saudi-arabia-summons-iraqs-ambassador-over-drone-attacks-on-kingdom-gulf-states/3903028 (AA)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Peruvian general election]]
**[[Peruvians]] vote to elect 130 members of the [[Congress of the Republic of Peru|Chamber of Deputies]] and 60 members of a newly created [[senate]], while also determining the top two [[President of Peru|presidential]] candidates that will advance to a [[run-off election]]. [https://apnews.com/article/peru-presidential-election-crime-fujimori-aliaga-980a5ee78d1fed794dc6c9b90f9a1ce4 (AP)]
**[[National Police of Peru|Peruvian police]] and prosecutors conduct searches at the [[National Office of Electoral Processes|electoral authority]]'s headquarters and a private company as part of an investigation into delays in delivering voting materials that prevent more than 60,000 people from voting. Officials attribute the issue to logistical failures affecting multiple polling stations in [[Lima]]. The electoral authority later announces that some polling stations will reopen. [https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/world/2026/04/13/perus-police-investigators-raid-election-hq-amid-vote-delays (AFP via ''Free Malaysia Today'')] [https://www.nampa.org/text/22908458 (AFP via NAMPA)]
**Exit polls show [[Popular Force]]'s [[Keiko Fujimori]] leading the presidential election with about 16 percent of the vote, with no candidate securing a majority and a run-off expected between Fujimori and [[Popular Renewal]]'s [[Rafael López Aliaga]]. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2026/04/13/peru-exit-polls-show-fujimori-ahead-runoff-likely_6752352_4.html (AFP with ''Le Monde'')]
*[[2026 Beninese presidential election]]
**[[Beninese]] citizens vote to elect a [[President of Benin|president]] that will succeed the incumbent [[Patrice Talon]] and serve for the next seven years. [[Ministry of Economy and Finance (Benin)|Finance minister]] [[Romuald Wadagni]] and [[Cowry Forces for an Emerging Benin|FCBE]] candidate [[:fr:Paul Hounkpè|Paul Hounkpè]] are the only two candidates on the ballot. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/benin-finance-minister-expected-coast-presidential-election-win-2026-04-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 Hungarian parliamentary election]]
**[[Hungarians]] vote to elect all 199 members of the [[National Assembly (Hungary)|National Assembly]]. The incumbent [[Prime Minister of Hungary|prime minister]], [[Viktor Orbán]], who was seeking a fifth consecutive term in office, [[Concession (politics)|concedes]] defeat and calls [[Tisza Party]] leader [[Péter Magyar]] on the telephone to congratulate him on his victory. The [[Pro-Europeanism|pro-European]] Tisza Party wins two-thirds of the seats in Hungary's legislature. The turnout is the highest since the [[End of communism in Hungary|fall of communism]], at 77.8%. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/c2d8zw2d3rkt (BBC)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/apr/12/hungary-election-latest-results-viktor-orban-peter-magyar-fidesz-tisza-russia-europe-live-news-updates#maincontent (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2026 Iraqi presidential election]]
**[[Nizar Amidi]], elected the previous day, takes office as [[President of Iraq]], succeeding [[Abdul Latif Rashid]]. [https://qna.org.qa/en/news/news-details?id=new-iraqi-president-officially-assumes-office&date=12/04/2026 (Qatar News Agency)]
